Plot a fitted length of stay survival curve

Source: R/fit_los.R
plot.los_fit.Rd

Renders the recovered survival curve P(LOS > d) for d = 0..max_stay as a step line, with the family and fitted parameters shown as a subtitle. Useful for sanity checking a fit_los() result before passing it to fcast_census().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'los_fit'
plot(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A los_fit object from fit_los().

...

Unused, present for S3 generic consistency.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

set.seed(1)
true_surv <- spec_los("negbin", mu = 3, k = 2, max_stay = 30)
admissions <- rpois(120, 20)
census <- stats::convolve(admissions, rev(true_surv), type = "open")[
  seq_along(admissions)
]
fit <- fit_los(
  data.frame(admissions = admissions, census = census),
  family = "negbin", max_stay = 30
)
plot(fit)
